Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the intro — we’re excited to see Redwood in action. Sanjay (our Head of Platform) and I wanted to lock an exec-level demo with our CIO (VP-level backing). High-level asks:
- 30–40 minute demo aimed at CIO/CTO/VPE; one of our execs will join for the first 15.
- A 15-minute dry run with a senior PM/engineer from your team the day before.
- Briefing doc or one-pager ahead of time (security and integration touchpoints).

Availability notes: CIO team prefers mornings PT next week, but Sanjay can do an afternoon slot if needed. Can you share 2–3 windows that include an option for the CIO + an alternate slot where the CTO can stand in?

Attached: rough internal requirements doc (we’ll follow up with a security contact).

Best,

Director, Strategic Integrations
OrionLine

Hi Lara — great to meet you. Thanks for the context and the ask list. Short reply with concrete options below, and I’ve cc’d Ben (exec briefing owner) and Priyom (technical lead) for coverage.

Proposed exec demo windows (PT):
- Option A: Wed, Jul 30 — 11:00–11:45 AM (CIO + CTO available)
- Option B: Thu, Jul 31 — 09:00–09:40 AM (CIO joins first 15; CTO on standby)
- Option C: Fri, Aug 1 — 10:30–11:10 AM (CTO attends; CIO alternative)

Dry run slots (15–20m) we can offer the day before: Tue/Wed 30 min windows at 3:00 PM or 4:00 PM PT. If none of those work we can do an earlier morning dry run on the day-of.

Pre-reads: attaching a one-pager and a short run-of-show. The one-pager includes a quick note on our hosting modes (hosted, dedicated, private) and the security page the SOC folks usually ask for.

Logistics notes:
- We recommend the CIO sees the executive summary + cost/latency highlights in the first 10 minutes.
- Priyom will own any technical deep-dive and is available for the dry run.

Next steps: pick the best exec slot and a dry-run window; we’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0142
